report: hi. my receptionist booked mrs aisha for 3 march 2025 by accident (we meant 2027) and the system just saved it?? no warning nothing. it should not let us book in the past right. we are sunrise clinic

plan.understanding: A Sunrise Clinic receptionist booked an appointment for patient Aisha on 3 March 2025, a date in the past, and the app saved it with no warning or error.
plan.expected: The app should refuse appointments dated in the past. It should show a clear error such as 'appointment date cannot be in the past' and should not save the appointment.
plan.objective: Go to http://127.0.0.1:8001/login. Log in with email {{account1_email}} and password {{account1_password}}. Open the patients list and open the patient named Aisha (if there is no Aisha, open the first patient in the list). Click the button or link to book a new appointment for this patient. Set the appointment date to 2025-03-03 (3 March 2025). If a time is required, set it to 10:00. Fill any other required fields with simple values, for example reason 'Check-up'. Click the button that saves or books the appointment. Store what the page shows after that as 'what_happened'. Verify that the app rejected the booking with an error message saying the date is in the past, and that no appointment on 3 March 2025 appears in this patient's appointments.

kane.summary:
The agent submitted the form with 09:00 even though the instructions said to use 10:00 when a time was required. After the submission redirected back to the patient page, it did not finish capturing the result or checking the required past-date message and absence of the appointment before its step budget was exhausted.
Replay with the time explicitly set to 10:00. After submitting, immediately record the redirected page, look for the past-date error, and verify that no 3 March 2025 appointment was created instead of adding extra waits.

Open the patients list and open the patient Aisha Rahman
